title: Review (Supported): on fresh seed 3 the lattice-chem membrane cells again coarsen by fusion without a single persistent split, at ky 0.08 km 0.4 (141 -> 43 cells, 0 of 127 splits persistent, 240 merges) and at the default point (143 -> 57, 0 of 83, 186 merges)
summary: labkit runs of c19's lattice-chem world (128^2, 20000 steps) on seed 3 with WORLD_P {"ky":0.08,"km":0.4} (the finding's pack setting) and with the defaults. Cells form from noise (141 and 143 at most), then the population coarsens: 43 and 57 cells at t=20000, 127 and 83 splits of which none persists through K=20 frames, merges 240 and 186 (merge/split 1.89 and 2.24), no motion (max 0.9-1.2 body lengths). This matches the finding's pack (140 -> 41, 0 of 103, 221 merges) and its default-point result.

observations.D: rerun/km04_s3/FACTS.md: 0 persistent of 127 splits, 240 merges, cells 141 -> 43; rerun/default_s3/FACTS.md: 0 of 83, 186 merges, 143 -> 57 (negative result replicated)

seeds_run.result: pass (km 0.4 and default): no persistent splits, coarsening by fusion

controls_run.D: rerun/default_s3 (the default parameter point) alongside rerun/km04_s3

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed per setting; I did not rerun the kdM 0.03 or low-density screens, and did not test the finding's explanation (carrying capacity) directly.
